messages:
harper (Finance): Noticing an oddity on GCP Marketplace settlement GCP-SETTLE-5581. Partner EdgeLabs reports promo discount not applied to prorated renewal lines for customer EL-77 from 2026-05-05 to 2026-05-12. Estimated partner undercredit USD 6,200. Need a settlement adjustment before close. @toni @lee
lee (Sales): Contract note: partner had a time-limited 15% partner rebate on May activations; migration script applied rebate to full-month SKU but not prorated lines. cc @margo for accounting impact.
toni (Partner Ops): I pulled reseller_mappings and promo rules. Looks like the promo flag missing on generated prorate SKU rows. @billing-bot can you fetch the prorate lines for EL-77 May 1-15 and attach raw CSV?
billing-bot: Query complete. Found 5 prorate lines (IDs: GP-9001..GP-9005). Promo_flag=false on prorate rows, promo_rate=15% on monthly rows. Calculated missing partner credit = USD 6,200. Created internal ticket FIN-3728. Uploaded CSV to drive: https://redwood.internal/drive/el-77-prorate-lines.csv
harper (Finance): Thanks. Looks like exposure is partner underpayment (we owe partner a settlement adjustment) not double billing, but partner also says some end-customers were charged full price. Need to confirm pass-through. @aziz can you draft credit memo and GL?
aziz (RevOps): Drafting. Quick Q: Do we issue a single settlement adjustment to EdgeLabs and let them credit end-customers, or do we request GCP to reissue adjusted invoices to end-customers? Typical flow is settlement adj to partner. Partner asked us to handle re-invoicing but GCP reissue flows take 4-6 weeks. Recommend settlement adj.
margo (Accounting): For month close, we'll book a provisional contra under GL 4213 (Marketplace partner adjustments) pending settlement. Need formal approval and partner signed request attached.
harper (Finance): Toni, please attach partner migration/promo request and any signed acknowledgement.
toni (Partner Ops): Uploaded promo agreement and partner email: https://redwood.internal/drive/edgelabs-promo-agreement.pdf
aziz (RevOps): Draft credit memo text:

```
Credit memo to EdgeLabs (partner id EL-77)
Amount: USD 6,200
Reason: Missing partner rebate on prorated GCP Marketplace lines during subscription renewal (2026-05-05 to 2026-05-12).
Related settlement: GCP-SETTLE-5581
GL code: 4213 (Marketplace partner adjustments)
Internal ticket: FIN-3728
Attachments: prorate CSV, promo agreement
```

Approvers: @harper, @felix (Finance Lead).
felix (Finance Lead): Approved pending sanity check by Accounting. margo, confirm GL and I'll sign off. :white_check_mark:
margo (Accounting): Confirm GL 4213 and I'll post provisional entry. Please route credit memo to GCP Marketplace billing ops with FIN-3728 attached.
billing-bot: Submitted settlement adjustment request to GCP Marketplace: ticket GCP-SETTLE-5581. ETA 5-9 business days. FIN-3728 linked.
harper (Finance): Logged provisional contra in the close workbook under "pending partner adjustments". I'll notify the partner about expected timeline and that we issued a settlement adj to EdgeLabs.
lee (Sales): Notifying partner: we will issue settlement adjustment; if they need us to pursue re-invoicing to end-customers we can open a GCP reissue request but it will be slower.
toni (Partner Ops): Notified partner and attached the settlement ticket. :thumbsup:
